// diagnostic

E0367

Pattern `{name}` needs a leading `.`.

What

Pattern `{name}` needs a leading `.`.

Why

Match patterns take a leading dot so the name isn't read as a variable or call (D-ENUMDOT1).

Fix

Write `.{name}` or `.{name}(…)`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0367: tests/ui/enum_pattern_needs_dot.stderr.

Error [E0367]: pattern `Red` needs a leading `.`
  --> tests/ui/enum_pattern_needs_dot.jet:9:9
    |
  9 |         Red -> { print("bare unit") }
    |         ^^^
 Why: match patterns take a leading dot so the name isn't read as a variable or call (D-ENUMDOT1)
 Fix: write `.Red`
